title: Flow
description: How several agents cooperate on one job. Engine-agnostic: an engine turns it into something runnable (kernel 0.3: a Claude Code skill).

argument_hint.description: Shown next to the command, e.g. "[target]".

default.description: Used when the user gives no input.

report.description: What the final report to the user contains.

agent.description: Role or role-variant id, without the prefix (e.g. verifier-security).

fanout.description: Agents run in parallel on the same inputs.

goal.description: The task goal handed to the agent(s).

in.description: Inputs: '$input', '$<step>' or '$<step>.<output|findings|artifacts|questions|summary|checks>' refer to earlier results; anything else is literal text.

when.description: Run the step only if an earlier step's handoffs meet the condition.

gate.description: auto = continue; human = wait for approval; on-questions = wait only when there are questions.
